# EthioCosmos Learning Community

## Overview
EthioCosmos is an astronomy learning community focused on accessible space science education from Ethiopia to the universe. The website provides public information and learning tools, while signed-in users can access protected learning content and user features.

## Main website areas
- Home: astronomy introduction, featured learning content, and space news.
- Learning: astronomy topics, subtopics, and lessons.
- Materials: organized photo galleries, videos, and documents/PDF resources.
- Progress: a Mission Control dashboard for learning progress, achievements, and skill development.
- AI Tutor: an astronomy-focused tutor for questions and guided learning.
- Chat/Channels: community discussion and posts.
- Join Stream: available classrooms and scheduled live classroom sessions when provided by the service.
- About: information about the EthioCosmos project and community.
- Subscription: displays current premium access information and manual payment/submission workflows when enabled by the administrator.

## Access rules
Public pages can be browsed without signing in. Learning, materials, progress, chat, tests, bookmarks, and other protected features may require an account. Premium-only capabilities are explicitly marked in the interface. Offline lesson and material downloads are user-initiated and are not downloaded automatically in the background.

## Current app behavior
The website and Android app use cached content with silent stale-while-revalidate updates. Previously visited lessons and materials should remain visible while background refreshes complete. The app avoids the previous aggressive 20-second premium polling loop and deduplicates concurrent CMS/news requests to reduce blinking, data usage, CPU work, and battery drain.

## Android app
The site offers the official EthioCosmos Android APK through the visible “Download APK” action. This is a direct Android APK download, not a PWA installation. The website does not advertise or provide a PWA install flow.

## Important limitations
Content, classroom availability, premium access, news, and community posts depend on the service's current data and account permissions. Do not infer that a lesson, classroom, premium entitlement, payment approval, or live stream exists unless the website displays it for the current user.

## Canonical links
- Website: https://ethiocosmos-learning-community.vercel.app/
- APK download: https://ethiocosmos-learning-community.vercel.app/api/download/apk
